caption_format: one UTF-8 text file per source image stem
caption_policy: describe visible variable content only: subject, ingredients, vessels, props, setting objects, and actions
do not describe photographic style, lighting quality, camera angle, composition, depth of field, color grade, or commercial finish
leave shared style in the pixels so the style LoRA can learn it as residual
avoid unsupported ingredient or dish claims
keep generator output separate until human review and final training-set selection
